title: PROJECT V — Common definitions
description: Shared value types used across PROJECT V normalized data schemas. All field names are camelCase. Units are stated explicitly in each description so that the Simulation agent (PV-3) TypeScript types can mirror them without ambiguity.

gameWorldPosition.description: A point in VALORANT game-world Unreal units (uu; 1 uu = 1 cm). This is the canonical cross-engine frame, owned by the Spatial agent (origin/claude/pv-spatial: datasets/spatial/ascent/coordinate-system.json, valorant-api transform verified by PV-6 on 3001 real samples). Synthetic scenario positions use zone representative points from the Ascent navgraph.

vector2.description: DEPRECATED (to be removed). 2D point in minimapUnits (VLR 2D-replay minimap frame). The vlr.gg frame is no longer used (its ToS bars the source and the ×1000 normalization caused an adapter mis-map in PV-3's F1). Use gameWorldPosition instead. Kept only for legacy event/position Layer-B stubs.

anyPosition.description: A position in EITHER the canonical game-world uu frame (v2, gameWorldPosition, which carries frame='game-world-uu') OR the deprecated minimapUnits frame (v1, vector2, {x,y} only). Accepts both so a loader can validate v1 and v2 DecisionContext/event documents during the v1→v2 transition (formatVersion distinguishes them). The two branches are mutually exclusive: gameWorldPosition requires `frame`, vector2 forbids extra properties.

vector3.description: 3D point in game-world units. VALORANT's native engine unit is the Unreal unit (1 uu approx 1 cm). Populated only when a true 3D source (replay decode) is available; null/absent for minimap-only sources.

side.description: Team side for a round. Matches VCT Reference rounds.side.

mapName.description: VALORANT map display name. Enum reflects the 13 distinct map_name values actually present in the VCT Reference dataset (2026-11-12 build).

roundOutcome.description: How a round ended. Enum reflects the 4 non-null rounds.outcome values present in VCT Reference.

armorKind.description: Armor tier. Enum mirrors vctstats ReplayPageParser.armorName() normalization.

evidenceType.description: Provenance evidence tier (README SS13.3). observed=directly published/seen; decoded=from a replay binary; derived=computed from other recorded fields; inferred=estimated with uncertainty; simulated=synthetic, not from any real match.
